summary: The segmenter tends to cut right after contrastive/continuative connectives (-는데, -지만) and before tag questions, stripping subject or tense context that the next clause needed, causing the worst quality drops. Simultaneously it under-splits clearly multi-clause sentences that contain safe -고/그래서/그런데/question-mark boundaries, sacrificing latency for no quality benefit. Rules should protect contrast/tag-question junctions while actively splitting on additive/causal connectives and internal punctuation.
